4 4 3 2 What is a deck-building game? In a deck-building game, every player starts with a small number of cards. These cards are called a deck. In the course of the game, the players can  build up and improve their personal deck with other cards by using the cards they already have. The words “deck” and “build” combine to form the  term “deck-building” game.
